LightningComponentBundle.description: Cmd/Ctrl-K compact window at the bottom right, from an eager utility bar item: brief an account, ask anything about your data, drill into any row.

property.name: corner
property.label: Corner
property.description: Where the launcher and the compact window sit: right, or left for a utility bar mirrored to the right.

property.name: expandEnabled
property.label: Right rail
property.description: Turns on the right rail: the Expand buttons and Cmd/Ctrl-Shift-K open a full-height side panel with the same conversation and the account's context.
